scope: Approach writer gates and f32 pitch histories through zero. Compare deterministic SimFixed pitch and completion tick counts; does not prove full horizontal Process, AircraftUnload, animation or landing.
assumptions: Real Aircraft/Type/Fly tables and ctor. Supplied nonnegative distance, SlowdownDistance, speed, health and stack-local IsDropship flag. Original degree constant. Native control word supplied by shared Fixture.
Landing decay range is entered at sampled height0; calling it is explicitly separate from full landing effects and admission.
